title: Supporting the Digital Autonomy of Elders Through LLM Assistance

live_model.evidence: "The developed assistant-defining prompt is tested on GPT-4-Turbo (OpenAI 2023) and Claude-3-Opus"; 4-task qualitative experience report

prompt.location: Main text (SAGE 0.1 assistant-defining instructions quoted in full)
prompt.note: System prompt is printed verbatim; per-task user messages are paraphrased narratively, not quoted.

claim.metric: none (narrative comparison of GPT vs Claude responses across 4 pilot tasks; no score, rate, or count reported)
claim.location: n/a ("Experience Report" and "Conclusions" sections are purely qualitative)

data.source: 4 ad hoc real-world ICT-skill tasks devised by the authors; not released as a dataset

notes: AAAI Spring Symposium Series 2024 (held March 2024, before GPT-4 Turbo's 2024-04-09 GA); the "(OpenAI 2023)" citation and symposium timing both point to the November 2023 preview, a retired snapshot. Independently, the paper reports only qualitative, task-by-task narrative comparisons with no quantitative claim.
